## **The Triple Option Returns for Season 3 on August 24**


08.24.2026


***Biggest Names. Biggest Games. College Football’s Premier Podcast is Back for a New Season***


BALTIMORE, August 24, 2026 –


***The Triple Option*** *,* the biggest show in college football, is back for a third season. Sinclair’s AMP Media today announced that Season 3 of


*The Triple Option* video podcast


**** hosted by


**Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II,** and


**Rob Stone** delivers unparalleled insights, debate, and storytelling from some of the most recognized voices in sports.


*The Triple Option’s* new season kicks off today with


Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith.


Meyer, 3x National Champion Head Coach at Ohio State and Florida, takes the audience inside the mind of the decision-makers, and explores championship caliber leadership and locker room culture. Ingram, National Champion and Heisman Trophy winner at Alabama and NFL veteran running back with the New Orleans Saints, Baltimore Ravens, and Houston Texans, gives the player perspective, with Stone bringing more than two decades of experience covering sports as a broadcaster.


“The passion of college football fans is what drives


*The Triple Option* ,” said Coach Urban Meyer. “Whether we're breaking down the biggest games, discussing the decisions coaches face, or sharing stories from our own experiences, we're giving fans an authentic conversation every week. I'm looking forward to another great season with Mark and Rob.


”


*The Triple Option* is regularly ranked as one of Apple’s top Sports Podcasts and key show moments have been covered by numerous media outlets including


*ESPN, Sports Illustrated, Yahoo, Men’s Journal, USA Today* and more.


“


*The Triple Option* has established itself as the preeminent destination for all college football fans, with insight from the game’s most respected voices. We’re raising the bar in Season 3, and expanding our premium content across all platforms, bringing fans closer to the players, teams, and sport they love,” said Rich Cooke, VP of Audio Programming.


Season 3 proudly continues its presenting sponsorship partnership Wendy’s for a third consecutive year. Visit Las Vegas and DraftKings join


*The Triple Option* this season as segment sponsors, with more to be announced.


“


*The Triple Option* has become a must-watch destination for college football fans and a powerful platform for brands looking to connect with one of the most passionate audiences in sports,” said Eric Welles, SVP / Chief Sports and Digital Monetization Officer. “The continued support of returning partners, alongside new sponsors joining this season, is a testament to the show's momentum and the value it delivers for both fans and advertisers.”


*The Triple Option’s* first two seasons featured interviews with a roster of high-profile guests including Roger Goodell, NFL Commissioner; Ryan Day, Ohio State Head Coach and ’24 National Champion; Curt Cignetti, Indiana Head Coach and Defending National Champion; Nick Saban, Former Alabama Head Coach; Dan Lanning, Oregon Head Coach; Marcus Freeman, Notre Dame Head Coach; Fernando Mendoza, 2025 Heisman Winner and 2026 NFL Draft #1 Pick; Charles Woodson, Pro Football HOF CB; Derrick Henry, Baltimore Ravens Running Back; Mack Brown, College Football HOF HC; Greg Sankey, SEC Commissioner; and Charlie Baker, NCAA President, among others.


Fans can catch


*The Triple Option* on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and all major podcast platforms, and stay connected on social media by following the show on Instagram, TikTok, X and Facebook at


**@3XOptionShow** .


*New episodes drop every Monday evening.*


T


*he Triple Option* is part of AMP Media’s podcast network which includes


*Unfiltered Soccer* with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,


*Throwbacks* with Matt Leinart and Jerry Ferrara,


*Post Moves* with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,


*Cousins* with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady and


*Style of Play* with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt.


**About AMP Sports:**


AMP Sports, a division of Sinclair’s AMP Media, connects brands to passionate sports fans with national scale, regional impact and local relevance. AMP Sports distributes highly engaging programming across linear and digital platforms, powered by a growing slate of original video podcasts, including


*The Triple Option* ,


*Unfiltered Soccer* ,


*Post Moves* ,


*Throwbacks* ,


*Cousins* and


*Style of Play* . AMP Sports also produces and distributes a robust network of college and professional football shows. With trusted sports personalities and high-profile athlete hosts, AMP Sports delivers deep audience engagement and impactful brand integration.


**About Sinclair:**
Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 178 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR, and The Nest. Sinclair’s content portfolio includes AMP Media, which produces a growing slate of original programming across multiple platforms. For more information, please visit
